{"sql":"WITH organic_cohorts AS (
  SELECT user_id, signup_ts, date_trunc('month', signup_ts)::DATE AS cohort_month
  FROM users
  WHERE lower(channel) = 'organic'
    AND signup_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01'
), monthly AS (
  SELECT c.cohort_month,
         count(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS signups,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(e.event_type) LIKE '%activ%' THEN c.user_id END) AS activated,
         count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(e.event_type) LIKE '%activ%' AND e.event_ts < c.signup_ts + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN c.user_id END) AS activated_30d,
         string_agg(DISTINCT e.event_type, ', ' ORDER BY e.event_type) AS observed_event_types
  FROM organic_cohorts c
  LEFT JOIN funnel_events e
    ON e.user_id = c.user_id
   AND e.event_ts >= c.signup_ts
   AND e.event_ts < c.signup_ts + INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY c.cohort_month
), rates AS (
  SELECT *, activated_30d::DOUBLE / NULLIF(signups, 0) AS activation_rate_30d
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT cohort_month, signups, activated_30d, activation_rate_30d,
       observed_event_types,
       (SELECT stddev_samp(activation_rate_30d) FROM rates
         WHERE cohort_month >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND cohort_month < DATE '2026-03-01') AS historical_monthly_sd_before_march_2026
FROM rates
ORDER BY cohort_month","rationale":"Measures 30-day activation for organic signup cohorts by month and reports pre-March monthly variation; the event-type list makes the activation-event definition auditable."}
